title: FireCal Harmonized Active Fire Record (MODIS→VIIRS), 2003–present
description:
Monthly active-fire activity in VIIRS-equivalent fire-days for every country and every 1° cell, built from NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 and VIIRS S-NPP 375 m archives.

MODIS-only years (2003–2011) are harmonized to VIIRS units with a season-stratified, hierarchically shrunk transfer with a small-fire floor, validated blind on held-out overlap years, with 90% intervals. The package also contains fire radiative energy and CO₂/CO/PM2.5 emission estimates, a MODIS detection-probability model from same-overpass VIIRS/Aqua matchups, and a Terra/Aqua orbit-drift analysis.

Formats: CF-1.8 NetCDF, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF, CSV, STAC 1.0, Frictionless datapackage. Methods: ATBD.md.

Independent project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026; not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA. Underlying detections: NASA FIRMS (ESDIS).
